name: Humans
description: Leverages the recruit mechanic to generate creature tokens while drawing extra cards, then buffs the team for the win.

name: Goblins
description: Uses amass to build a growing Army token that can be sacrificed for value, draining opponents while accumulating resources.

name: Wolves
description: Gets large creatures (power 4+) onto the battlefield quickly, then leverages ferocious for card advantage.

name: Dwarves
description: Builds toward 3+ artifacts, legendaries, and/or Sagas to unlock an enduring story, then cashes in on storied payoffs.

name: Elves
description: A controlling strategy built around landfall, shutting opponents down while building toward increasingly powerful creatures.
